title: Gary Webb and CIA cocaine in the inner city

tellings.quote:
Gary Webb, the guy that knew the CIA
brought Coke into the hood.

plain: The comedian Kurt Metzger brings up Gary Webb, a journalist who reported that cocaine tied to CIA-backed groups flowed into poor American neighbourhoods in the 1980s, calling him "the guy that knew the CIA brought coke into the hood." Metzger mentions him in passing as an example of someone who exposed what the government was hiding, which, if true, would mean the CIA helped feed the drug trade in American cities.
